searchText: double-checking there's no way to bookmark/star messages in Discord? The discord moderators can pin messages for the channel But no way bookmark them personally if that's what you're asking You can copy a link to a message and save it elsewhere. > You can copy a link to a message and save it elsewhere. <@!301186049323958275> thanks that's what I did Is there an easy way to add a +1 thumb to a comment in Discord? It seems like the shortlist of emoji is expertly crafted to be those I don't use. <@361447803194441738> Either right click on the message and choose "Add reaction" (click on it so you get a more usable dialog with search) or hover over the message and click the little emoji icon that appears on the right. <@!301186049323958275>, thanks. That's how I've been doing it but I was hoping there was a method that didn't involve two clicks and some typing. Or if you are on Windows you can press `<windows-key>-<period-key>` to open the universal OS emoji picker. I have a script that adds a hotkey if you prefer. Its a bit advanced. He uses Arch btw 😂 Hahah its all good thanks, I'll just handle the clicks for now. Press ctrl-shift-i to open the dev console in Discord then paste in this and hit enter: ```js window.addEventListener('keydown', event => { if (!event.shiftKey || !event.ctrlKey || event.key != '|') return const container = document.querySelector('main.chatContent-a9vAAp > .messagesWrapper-3lZDfY > .scrollerWrap-2lJEkd > .scroller-2FKFPG > div > div:nth-last-of-type(2)') container.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', { bubbles: true })); container.querySelector('div[aria-label="Add Reaction"]').click() }) ``` It's like they suppress the +1 from becoming a suggested one. Once that is done, you can press `ctrl-shift-\` to pop-up the emoji picker with focus on the search box. They actually started doing that in the latest discord update <@!361447803194441738> Another option is to type `+:thumbsup:` as a standalone message to add it as a reaction to the last message in the chat window. +👍 Without typos. 😉 I like that better, no mouse touching! The reason I added the hotkey is because I would often start typing my reaction with `+:...` and by the time I found a good reaction a new message showed up in the channel and I would react to the wrong thing. The hotkey makes it so it "attaches" to the message as soon as I hit the hotkey, then I can take my time picking the *just right* emoji for the job. 😉 Oh thats a good point, you don't want +1 the wrong thing! If you are quick, you can usually land it on the right message with typing though. Just doesn't give time to really sit and contemplate your reaction choices. from the latest changelog, no joke "frequently used emoji no longer count to frequently used emoji" basically useless. Table flipping no longer counts I guess? (╯°□°）╯︵ ┻━┻
